impact_narrative: payments-db is saturated and both checkout and orders are failing behind it, affecting roughly 2,000 database-backed requests per minute.
cause_summary: Commit b7c8d9e0f1 raised the payments-db statement timeout from 5s to 60s and added an on-demand reporting query; long reporting reads now hold connections for a minute and exhaust the pool. It shipped 25 minutes before the alert.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Orders Database Runbook > Connection pool exhaustion
runbook_citation.why: Covers pool saturation triage and warns that a recent change holding connections is the usual cause.

next_steps: Roll back b7c8d9e0f1 to restore the 5s statement timeout, then confirm idle connections recover.
Terminate the running reporting queries with pg_terminate_backend to release the pool now.
Move the revenue rollup to a read replica with its own connection budget before re-landing it.
